title: Tech Note: 4D Live Window 1.1 - Invoices Demo Database
author: Robert Molina, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note showcases 4D Live Window (4DLW) 1.1, a plug-in area for embedding and interacting with HTML/PDF/Office documents inside a 4D form, using an Invoices demo to show new 1.1 features like navigation callbacks and click interception, positioned as an alternative to subforms/buttons for building rich, HTML-styled displays inside a classic 4D client interface. The plug-in-based, per-click callback approach to embedding a browser control in a native form is a period-appropriate solution now superseded by native web-view/webform integration and by the shift toward building UIs directly on the web via 4D's Web Server and Qodly components rather than embedding HTML fragments inside desktop client windows.
related_updates: 4D Live Window (4DLW) as a standalone Web 2.0 Pack plug-in has been discontinued along with 4D Web 2.0 Pack
4D now offers built-in HTML/web-view form area objects for embedding web content directly in 4D forms without a separate plug-in
Modern 4D UI approaches favor building rich interfaces with 4D's native Web Server and Qodly components over embedding HTML mash-ups inside desktop client forms
